profile.headline: Technical writer, developer, and software designer at AccountingWare
profile.summary:
I love exceeding expectations, raising the quality bar, and inspiring others to do work that inspires them. I thrive in a small company or business unit environment where I can contribute as a performer, mentor, and leader, and where my efforts make a meaningful difference.

Specialties: Writing, editing, software testing, managing cross-functional teams, project leadership, data analysis, process analysis, mentoring, strategic thinking, problem identification and problem solving

positions.title: Technical Writer/Software Developer/Software Designer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain online help systems incorporating HTML5, CSS3, 
JavaScript, jQuery.

Prepare web-based release notes to inform users about details of software 
updates.

Suggest improvements to the software’s user interface.

Perform programming to maintain federal and state income tax withholding 
calculations.

Research changes to federal and state income tax calculations, SUTA 
parameters, garnishment parameters, and federal form changes.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Development · Strategic Thinking · Technical Writing · Data Analysis

positions.title: Technical Editor/Courseware Developer
positions.description: Edited courseware. Supported students enrolled in online web development courses including HTML, CSS, PHP, SQL, and JavaScript. Analyzed student feedback and recommended improvements to the system.

positions.title: Technical Writer/Documentation & QA Manager/Content Administrator
positions.description:
I was hired as a technical writer, but was not limited by my job title. By reporting defects and suggesting improvements to the software, I demonstrated the value of software testing. My efforts led to the establishment of a formal quality assurance role.

As Documentation & QA Manager, I gradually built a team of eight writers and twelve software testers. I guided and participated in the development of documentation and in the testing of all product suites.

I spearheaded a leadership learning effort among the managers in software development. I coordinated learning lunches, made presentations, moderated discussions, encouraged other managers to participate, and engaged in extensive self-study.

I observed and evaluated processes in the Development department and recommended strategies for aligning practices with agile principles.

positions.title: Technical Writer/Usability Specialist
positions.description:
I wrote user manuals and training material for clients.

I trained a business analyst in software and web application testing techniques.

I observed and analyzed processes at a call center and made recommendations for process improvement.

positions.title: Technical Writer
positions.description: I wrote user manuals, reference guide articles, and online help.

positions.title: Technical Writer
positions.description:
I wrote user manuals and procedures to support the company's software services. I was fully responsible for research, writing, preparation, and testing of each manual.

I developed system test plans for software developed in-house. My test plans were instrumental in the company achieving and maintaining ISO 9001 registration.

I manually tested software services for function, usability, and data integrity, and worked closely with developers to resolve issues. I reported 70-80% of the defects that were discovered.

I developed a data generation tool using Excel and Access in order to create stable and reusable data for system testing.

positions.title: Technical Writer
positions.description:
I wrote and maintained user manuals, procedures, and online help for the company's event management software.

I performed system testing, made simple software customizations, and consulted with programmers on user interface improvements.

I worked with a software vendor to implement their documentation automation system. I identified errors that were specific to the company's environment and worked with the vendor and our systems programmer to resolve them. I proposed several enhancements that the vendor incorporated in later releases.
